article.title: Previous sanction of appropriate Government.
article.content: No Court shall take cognizance of an offence alleged to have been committed by an employee of the appropriate Government under this Chapter, except with the previous sanction of the appropriate Government or a complaint is filed by an officer authorised by it in this behalf.
article.html:
94Previous sanction of appropriate Government.

Section 94 · Chapter XVI · page 32 of the Act

No Court shall take cognizance of an offence alleged to have been committed by an employee of the appropriate Government under this Chapter, except with the previous sanction of the appropriate Government or a complaint is filed by an officer authorised by it in this behalf.
